issue.description:
The documented contract requires every successful mutation to publish the Git-tracked checkpoint automatically, while `sync flush-only` remains idempotent and `--no-auto-flush` plus `checkpoint.auto_flush` suppress publication. Add a conformance matrix covering all public mutation paths, process-exit durability, opt-outs, publisher failures, pointer/artifact consistency, and sync status reporting.
